text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear three-point structure","quality":"organization","description":"It presents its argument in a more deliberate sequence with an introduction, separate reasons, and a conclusion."},{"evidence":"“My first point… My second point… My third and final point”","quality":"logical development","description":"It develops the claim through distinct, connected reasons rather than mostly repeating the same idea."},{"evidence":"“unsafe,” “expensive,” “takes away chances”","quality":"argument breadth","description":"It offers multiple kinds of objections, giving the essay a broader argumentative range."},{"evidence":"“Imagine driving down the road and your car just suddenly malfunctions”","quality":"elaboration","description":"It explains its points with examples and scenarios instead of only making brief assertions."},{"evidence":"“The idea of driverless cars is ridiculous” / “I would never own one”","quality":"clear stance","description":"It states a firm position and returns to it in the opening and closing for emphasis."}]}
